“A Wide Welcome”
entries.meta: MIT Welcome Center | Cambridge, MA | June 2021 – Present
entries.text: Acrylic, wall paint on wood panel, 40" by 40". This artwork is a real-life part of [this Wide Tim Instagram post](https://www.instagram.com/p/CLPr1dgnLd5/) and was initially a part of the Borderline Storywall Mural project. Following the end of the project, this artwork was then individually selected by the MIT Welcome Center staff and is now on display in the Welcome Center semi-permanently.
